statement: Pinned CWiid's status thread reads A400FE/2 to classify a MotionPlus extension and the packet processor exposes the MotionPlus six-byte angle-rate and slow-mode fields for a single MotionPlus extension type. The inspected status and parser do not request Dolphin's A400F6/4 and A40040/16, and do not establish full simultaneous MP+Nunchuk state handling. Linux CWiid still needs physical Bluetooth L2CAP; no virtual-UHID runtime acceptance follows.

applicability.revision: Pinned consumer implementations in docs/wii-motionplus-consumer-comparison.md; no physical Wii Remote revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Pinned CWiid thread.c 155-215, process.c 235-252, connect.c 34-148; source-only and limited to this legacy implementation.
